# MRCD

> Local HTTP service and Python package (contract `mrcd.analysis/v1`) that detects filler words, prolongations and repetitions in Spanish speech from a mono 16 kHz PCM16 WAV. Exploratory results: scores are not calibrated. The trained checkpoint is not distributed (available on request).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, contract summary, hard rules, skills index
- [INTEGRACION.md](INTEGRACION.md): integration guide (Spanish): install, endpoints, examples, GPU, troubleshooting
- [README.md](README.md): project overview and quickstart
- [models/README.md](models/README.md): why the checkpoint is not distributed and how to request it

## Contract

- [JSON Schema mrcd.analysis.v1](mrcd/service/schemas/mrcd.analysis.v1.schema.json): response and job format
- [Contract source and error codes](mrcd/service/contract.py): `ERROR_CODES` with HTTP status and retryable flag
- [Server routes](mrcd/service/server.py): `/v1/health`, `/v1/schema`, `/v1/jobs`

- [Smoke test](scripts/docker_smoke.py)
